dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular circular and semi-circular rings with high-contrast transitions from dark pelage to light grey; perimeters exhibit non-uniform pixel width and jagged, crenulated boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Medium density of solid, high-intensity grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated between the larger ring structures in the mid-lateral and anterior sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent cluster of three large macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region forms a scalene triangle; a secondary grouping of three smaller annuli further posterior forms a roughly linear alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Chain-like interlocking of multiple annuli along the lower lateral edge creates a continuous, tessellated pattern of high-intensity pixels.
